from AlgorithmImports import *


class StrategySystemAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.required_symbols = [
            self.spy,
            self.aapl,
            self.ibm,
            self.bac,
            self.aig,
        ]

        self.spy_sma = self.SMA(self.spy, 100, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(
            self.aapl,
            14,
            MovingAverageType.Wilders,
            Resolution.Daily
        )

        self.prev_spy_close = None
        self.prev_spy_sma = None
        self.prev_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        self.SetWarmUp(100, Resolution.Daily)

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        spy_bar = data.Bars[self.spy] if self.spy in data.Bars else None
        aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl] if self.aapl in data.Bars else None

        if spy_bar is not None and self.spy_sma.IsReady:
            self.prev_spy_close = spy_bar.Close
            self.prev_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value

        if aapl_bar is not None:
            if self.prev_aapl_close is None:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0
            elif aapl_bar.Close < self.prev_aapl_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.prev_aapl_close = aapl_bar.Close

        if self.IsWarmingUp:
            return

        if not all(symbol in data.Bars for symbol in self.required_symbols):
            return

        if not self.spy_sma.IsReady or not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady:
            return

        spy_close = spy_bar.Close
        current_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value
        current_aapl_rsi = self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value

        upward_cross = (
            self.prev_spy_close is not None
            and self.prev_spy_sma is not None
            and self.prev_spy_close <= self.prev_spy_sma
            and spy_close > current_spy_sma
        )

        downward_cross = (
            self.prev_spy_close is not None
            and self.prev_spy_sma is not None
            and self.prev_spy_close >= self.prev_spy_sma
            and spy_close < current_spy_sma
        )

        if self.strategy_a_shares > 0 and downward_cross:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_shares)
            self.strategy_a_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_b_shares > 0 and current_aapl_rsi > 60:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_shares)
            self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_a_shares == 0 and upward_cross:
            shares = int(
                (0.40 * self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue) / spy_close
            )
            if shares > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, shares)
                self.strategy_a_shares = shares

        if self.strategy_b_shares == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
            if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20000:
                shares = int(20000 / aapl_bar.Close)
                if shares > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, shares)
                    self.strategy_b_shares = shares

            current_sma = float(self.spy_sma.Current.Value)

                self.previous_spy_close is not None
                and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
                and self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
                and spy_close > current_sma
            )

            downward_cross = (
                self.previous_spy_close is not None
                and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
                and self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma
                and spy_close < current_sma
            )

            self.previous_spy_close = spy_close
            self.previous_spy_sma = current_sma
        else:
            upward_cross = False
            downward_cross = False

        if aapl_bar is not None:
            aapl_close = float(aapl_bar.Close)

            if self.previous_aapl_close is not None:

                else:

            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_close

        if self.IsWarmingUp:
            return

        if any(symbol not in data.Bars for symbol in self.symbols):
            return

        aapl_rsi_above_60 = (
            self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
            and float(self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value) > 60.0
        )

        if self.strategy_a_lot > 0 and downward_cross:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)

        if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and aapl_rsi_above_60:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
            self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_a_lot == 0 and upward_cross:
            close = float(data.Bars[self.spy].Close)
            target_value = 0.40 * float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue)
            quantity = int(target_value // close)

            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                self.strategy_a_lot = quantity

                quantity = int(20000.0 // close)

                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                    self.strategy_b_lot = quantity

class TwoSlotStrategy(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_sma = self.SMA(self.spy, 100, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(
            self.aapl,
            14,
            MovingAverageType.Wilders,
            Resolution.Daily
        )

        self.spy_lot = 0
        self.aapl_lot = 0

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0
        self.previous_aapl_close = None

        self.SetWarmUp(100, Resolution.Daily)

    def OnData(self, data):
        available = {}

        for symbol in self.symbols:
            if symbol not in data.Bars:
                continue
            bar = data.Bars[symbol]
            if bar is None:
                continue
            available[symbol] = bar

        if self.spy in available and self.spy_sma.IsReady:
            current_spy_close = float(available[self.spy].Close)
            current_spy_sma = float(self.spy_sma.Current.Value)

            spy_up_cross = (
                self.previous_spy_close is not None and
                self.previous_spy_sma is not None and
                self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma and
                current_spy_close > current_spy_sma
            )

            spy_down_cross = (
                self.previous_spy_close is not None and
                self.previous_spy_sma is not None and
                self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma and
                current_spy_close < current_spy_sma
            )
        else:
            current_spy_close = None
            current_spy_sma = None
            spy_up_cross = False
            spy_down_cross = False

        if self.aapl in available:
            current_aapl_close = float(available[self.aapl].Close)

            if self.previous_aapl_close is not None:
                if current_aapl_close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            aapl_red_three_days = self.aapl_red_streak >= 3
        else:
            current_aapl_close = None
            aapl_red_three_days = False

        aapl_rsi_above_60 = (
            self.aapl_rsi.IsReady and
            float(self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value) > 60
        )

        if self.previous_spy_close is not None and current_spy_close is not None:
            self.previous_spy_close = current_spy_close
            self.previous_spy_sma = current_spy_sma
        elif current_spy_close is not None and self.spy_sma.IsReady:
            self.previous_spy_close = current_spy_close
            self.previous_spy_sma = current_spy_sma

        if current_aapl_close is not None:
            self.previous_aapl_close = current_aapl_close

        if self.IsWarmingUp:
            return

        if any(symbol not in available for symbol in self.symbols):
            return

        if self.spy_lot > 0 and spy_down_cross:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.spy_lot)
            self.spy_lot = 0

        if self.aapl_lot > 0 and aapl_rsi_above_60:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.aapl_lot)
            self.aapl_lot = 0

        if self.spy_lot == 0 and spy_up_cross:
            target_value = 0.40 * self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue
            quantity = int(math.floor(target_value / current_spy_close))

            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                self.spy_lot = quantity

        if self.aapl_lot == 0 and aapl_red_three_days:
            if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20000:
                quantity = int(math.floor(20000 / current_aapl_close))

                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                    self.aapl_lot = quantity

from QuantConnect import *
from QuantConnect.Algorithm import QCAlgorithm
from QuantConnect.Indicators import SimpleMovingAverage, RelativeStrengthIndex
from QuantConnect.Orders import OrderStatus


class FixedStrategyAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.symbols = {}
        for ticker in ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]:
            self.symbols[ticker] = self.AddEquity(
                ticker, Resolution.Daily
            ).Symbol

        self.spy = self.symbols["SPY"]
        self.aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]

        self.spy_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(100)
        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14)

        self.previous_spy_difference = None
        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0
        self.strategy_a_pending = False
        self.strategy_b_pending = False

        self.SetWarmUp(100, Resolution.Daily)

    def OnData(self, data):
        available = {}

        for ticker, symbol in self.symbols.items():
            if not data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol):
                continue
            available[ticker] = data.Bars[symbol]

        if "SPY" in available:
            spy_bar = available["SPY"]
            self.spy_sma.Update(spy_bar.EndTime, spy_bar.Close)

        if "AAPL" in available:
            aapl_bar = available["AAPL"]
            self.aapl_rsi.Update(aapl_bar.EndTime, aapl_bar.Close)

            if self.previous_aapl_close is not None:
                if aapl_bar.Close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_bar.Close

        spy_upward_cross = False
        spy_downward_cross = False

        if "SPY" in available and self.spy_sma.IsReady:
            spy_close = available["SPY"].Close
            current_difference = spy_close - self.spy_sma.Current.Value

            if self.previous_spy_difference is not None:
                spy_upward_cross = (
                    self.previous_spy_difference <= 0
                    and current_difference > 0
                )
                spy_downward_cross = (
                    self.previous_spy_difference >= 0
                    and current_difference < 0
                )

            self.previous_spy_difference = current_difference

        if self.IsWarmingUp:
            return

        if len(available) != len(self.symbols):
            return

        if (
            self.strategy_a_lot > 0
            and not self.strategy_a_pending
            and spy_downward_cross
        ):
            self.strategy_a_pending = True
            self.MarketOrder(
                self.spy,
                -self.strategy_a_lot,
                tag="STRATEGY_A_SELL"
            )

        if (
            self.strategy_b_lot > 0
            and not self.strategy_b_pending
            and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
            and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60
        ):
            self.strategy_b_pending = True
            self.MarketOrder(
                self.aapl,
                -self.strategy_b_lot,
                tag="STRATEGY_B_SELL"
            )

        if (
            self.strategy_a_lot == 0
            and not self.strategy_a_pending
            and spy_upward_cross
        ):
            spy_close = available["SPY"].Close
            shares = int(
                (self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * 0.40) / spy_close
            )

            if shares > 0:
                self.strategy_a_pending = True
                self.MarketOrder(
                    self.spy,
                    shares,
                    tag="STRATEGY_A_BUY"
                )

        if (
            self.strategy_b_lot == 0
            and not self.strategy_b_pending
            and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3
        ):
            aapl_close = available["AAPL"].Close

            if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20000:
                shares = int(20000 / aapl_close)

                if shares > 0:
                    self.strategy_b_pending = True
                    self.MarketOrder(
                        self.aapl,
                        shares,
                        tag="STRATEGY_B_BUY"
                    )

    def OnOrderEvent(self, order_event):
        if order_event.Status not in [
            OrderStatus.Filled,
            OrderStatus.PartiallyFilled,
            OrderStatus.Canceled,
            OrderStatus.Invalid,
            OrderStatus.Margin,
            OrderStatus.None_
        ]:
            return

        order = self.Transactions.GetOrderById(order_event.OrderId)
        tag = order.Tag if order is not None else ""
        fill_quantity = order_event.FillQuantity

        if tag == "STRATEGY_A_BUY":
            self.strategy_a_lot += fill_quantity
            if order_event.Status in [
                OrderStatus.Filled,
                OrderStatus.Canceled,
                OrderStatus.Invalid,
                OrderStatus.Margin
            ]:
                self.strategy_a_pending = False

        elif tag == "STRATEGY_A_SELL":
            self.strategy_a_lot = max(
                0, self.strategy_a_lot + fill_quantity
            )
            if order_event.Status in [
                OrderStatus.Filled,
                OrderStatus.Canceled,
                OrderStatus.Invalid,
                OrderStatus.Margin
            ]:
                self.strategy_a_pending = False

        elif tag == "STRATEGY_B_BUY":
            self.strategy_b_lot += fill_quantity
            if order_event.Status in [
                OrderStatus.Filled,
                OrderStatus.Canceled,
                OrderStatus.Invalid,
                OrderStatus.Margin
            ]:
                self.strategy_b_pending = False

        elif tag == "STRATEGY_B_SELL":
            self.strategy_b_lot = max(

            )
            if order_event.Status in [
                OrderStatus.Filled,
                OrderStatus.Canceled,
                OrderStatus.Invalid,
                OrderStatus.Margin
            ]:
                self.strategy_b_pending = False
